Actor Rajpal Yadav's property to be auctioned over unpaid debt

Actor Rajpal Yadav faces property auction due to a check bounce case and unpaid debt. A court-issued notice for the auction of his property in Shahjahanpur has been posted at his residence. The auction is scheduled for September 9 if Yadav fails to pay Rs 16 crore within 34 days. This action follows a check bounce case that has led to increasing difficulties for the actor.
